put.summary: Send from any mailbox over SMTP, read replies over IMAP; both logins are checked before anything is stored
put.description: Replaces the sender email channel, whatever it was before. Passwords are encrypted at rest and never returned. 422 with SMTP_AUTH_FAILED, IMAP_AUTH_FAILED, SMTP_UNREACHABLE, IMAP_UNREACHABLE, SMTP_REFUSED or IMAP_REFUSED when a login fails.

from.description: The address mail goes out from. Defaults to the SMTP user when that is an address, else the sender email.

host.description: The server name, like smtp.fastmail.com or imap.fastmail.com.

secure.description: true: TLS from the first byte (465, 993). false: STARTTLS, which is required unless the host is localhost.

user.description: The login, usually the full mailbox address.

password.description: Write-only: an app password where the provider has them. Stored encrypted, never returned or logged.
